captions.text: A whole island. Gone in one day.
Rings of land and water. Walls of red metal.
And they tell you it never existed.
Plato wrote it down. Twenty-four hundred years ago.
By midnight, you'll know where Atlantis went.
Clue one. He gave the size of every ring.
Brass. Tin. And a red metal nobody had ever seen.
But in twenty-four hundred years, nobody has found one stone.
